subject: Partner referral & onboarding terms — BrightLayer integration
messages:
From: Anna Patel <anna@brightlayer.co>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: partners@brightlayer.co
Date: 2026-01-11T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + referral program & integration kickoff

Hi Laura — great meeting last week.

BrightLayer is excited to explore a referral + reseller lite path with Redwood for consultancies we work with. High-level ask: can we align on a simple referral MOU (lead registration + 90-day attribution window) and a commission grid so we can train our partners this month?

To get the pilot moving, can your team confirm: 1) referral split (percentage of first year ARR or flat fee), 2) lead registration process (email vs portal + approval SLA), 3) sample co-sell collateral and 4) payment terms (net30/net45)?

I attached a short MOU and a commission grid we typically use — hoping we can iterate quickly.

Best,
Anna Patel
Head of Partnerships, BrightLayer
attachments: BL-Redwood-Referral-MOU_v1.pdf (PDF), RL-commission-grid.xlsx (Excel)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Anna Patel <anna@brightlayer.co>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-11T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + referral program & integration kickoff

Thanks Anna — happy to move quickly. A few notes from our side:

- Referral economics: Redwood prefers percentage of first-year ARR for strategic consultancies. For the pilot we can offer 18% of first-year ARR for standard referrals, 25% if BrightLayer helps close and signs an MSA as reseller (i.e., active co-sell). We can do a flat per-deal bounty for proof-of-concept (POC) projects — suggest $3,000 for POCs under $25k.
- Attribution window: 90 days is reasonable, but we propose a 120-day window if BrightLayer is listed as the primary referrer in hubspot and completes the lead registration form within 10 business days.
- Lead registration: email is OK to start (partners@redwood.ai), but we'll provision a partner portal link for the pilot. Registration SLA: we triage within 3 business days.
- Payments: net30 is preferable. For pilots we can issue a single consolidated invoice monthly.

Next steps: Marcus (cc) will propose minimal legal redlines to your MOU, and Steph will own ops (partner portal + onboarding checklist). If that sounds good, let's plan a 30-minute signature and ops kickoff on 2026-01-14.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Anna Patel <anna@brightlayer.co>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-12T08:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + referral program & integration kickoff

Laura / Anna — quick legal ops perspective:

- Commission payment mechanics: recommend 18% on recognized revenue (net of credits/refunds) paid within 30 days of invoice collection. Add a clawback clause if customer churns within 60 days post-payment.
- Lead registration: need minimal fields (company, contact, estimated ARR, qualifying notes) and a signature box confirming BrightLayer is the originator. We should enforce single-attribution (first valid registration wins) to avoid stacking.
- Reseller vs referral language: make sure MSA includes explicit permission for BrightLayer to resell (if they take reseller path) and limited SLA obligations.

I've attached a one-page redline summary and the commission payment schedule (spreadsheet). I'll keep legal language light for the pilot.

Marcus Lin
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: RL-commission-grid.xlsx (Excel)

From: Anna Patel <anna@brightlayer.co>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: partners@brightlayer.co, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-12T12:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + referral program & integration kickoff

Thanks Marcus — those guardrails work for us with two asks: 1) can we extend the reseller commission (25%) to cover co-sell motions where BrightLayer leads the demo and the deal >$100k, and 2) can marketing dev funds (MDF) be scoped later if the pilot shows lift?

Operationally, we can do the registration form today. For the portal, what's the list of partner roles we should provision (partner manager, sales, technical)? We'll add training slots for BrightLayer consultants.

Would you prefer a quick signature now and iterate the MSA wording? We use DocuSign for quick MOUs.

— Anna

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Anna Patel <anna@brightlayer.co>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-13T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + referral program & integration kickoff

Anna — great, we agree on both asks. Final decisions for the pilot: 

1) Economics: 18% of first-year ARR for referrals; 25% for co-sell (BrightLayer leads demo and deal >$100k). POC bounty: $3k for deals < $25k.
2) Attribution & registration: 120-day attribution if registration is within 10 business days to partners@redwood.ai. Single-attribution rule applies.
3) Payments: net30 on recognized revenue; monthly consolidated invoice. Clawback for churn within 60 days.
4) Ops: we'll provision partner portal accounts for up to 5 BrightLayer users (roles: partner_manager, sales_rep, technical_lead). Steph will schedule onboarding and training (two 60-min sessions).
5) MDF: agree to revisit MDF after Q1 pilot performance; no MDF in initial MOU.

Action: I'll upload the MOU to DocuSign and route to your signers today (see link). Marcus will add three light redlines to the MOU focusing on payment mechanics and liability caps. Please confirm signers and the portal user list.

If Anna confirms, let's sign by EOD Friday (2026-01-16) and kick off ops week of 2026-01-20.

Thanks — Laura
